resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Give red-first base runs the new fixtures their observer reads
body:
Outcome: the red-first base run gives the observer the new fixture files it reads (or briefs require observers to embed new captures), so a new fixture never makes red-first INCOMPLETE on ENOENT.
Evidence: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/predecessor-retire/ (PR #159). Review record 1 of PR #159: redFirstCauses INCOMPLETE "base: other" from ENOENT on test/fixtures/herdr/agent-get-idle-claude.reply.jsonl.
